title: IKEA PAX wardrobe with top cupboards

options.name: The design
options.text: Two IKEA PAX frames, 201 cm high, with three mirror doors along the wall beside the door: a 100 cm frame with two short hanging rails, and a 50 cm frame with four baskets and three shelves. They are built in with a scribed filler at the wall, a plinth panel and an end panel by the door. Above them a row of five made to measure MDF cupboards with push to open doors runs the whole width of the wall, the first three lined up with the mirror doors below and two over the door, with a plain panel above them up to the ceiling. Press Open the doors to see inside.

poster.alt: 3D model of a mirror door PAX wardrobe beside a panelled door, with a row of white top cupboards across the whole wall lined up with the doors below

notes: The sizes are taken roughly from the drawing and have not been measured yet: the wall width, ceiling height, plinth and top cupboard heights will be checked on site.
The PAX frames, doors, rails and baskets are IKEA's standard sizes; the heights of the rails, baskets and shelves inside can move.
The top cupboards, the fillers and the panels are made to measure in MDF.
Colours on screen are a guide; the mirror doors are shown plain.
